## 🐛 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of the bug encountered in the APEX // F1 application.

## 🔄 Reproduction Steps
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to Section '...' (e.g., `#dynasties`, `#simulator`, `#methodology`)
2. Select Filter / Slider '...' (e.g., Season 1988, Compound Soft C5)
3. Click on '...'
4. See error or unexpected visual / statistical output

## 🎯 Expected vs. Actual Behavior
- **Expected:** (e.g., Lap pace delta accurately shows +0.85s without legend collision)
- **Actual:** (e.g., Value NaN or overlapping axis labels)

## 📊 Environment & Telemetry Details
- **OS:** (e.g., Windows 11, macOS Sonoma, Ubuntu 22.04)
- **Python Version:** (e.g., 3.11.8, 3.12.2)
- **Reflex Version:** (e.g., 0.10.1)
- **Browser:** (e.g., Chrome 124, Firefox 125, Safari 17)

If applicable, add screenshots, Plotly layout inspects, or browser/terminal console logs to help explain your problem.
